seo.title: Private Driver in Korea | Pak Lee's Car
seo.description: Private van + driver in Korea from ₩150,000. Flexible schedule, halal-friendly, fuel and tolls included. Message Pak Lee on WhatsApp today.

hero.h1: You plan the day. I'll drive it.
hero.lede: A private van and one driver for the whole day — no fixed route, no group to keep up with, and no rush at the places you actually like.

message.body: No forms, and no deposit before we've spoken. Send me your dates and what you'd like to see. I'll tell you honestly what fits in a day and what doesn't.

items.q: How much does a private driver cost in Korea?
items.a: A full day with me and the van runs ₩300,000 to ₩400,000 depending on where you're going, priced per vehicle, not per person. Fuel, tolls and insurance are already in that price. Going into Gyeonggi-do, Chungcheong-do or Gangwon-do adds a bit more, and so does running past the 10-hour mark — see the exact numbers under Rates.

items.q: Can I change the plan during the day?
items.a: Yes. Nothing is booked with a tour company, so if you want to skip a stop or add one, we just do it.

items.q: Is this service halal or Muslim friendly?
items.a: Yes. I know which restaurants are actually halal, not just labeled that way, and I build prayer stops into the day without you having to ask twice.

items.q: How many people fit in the van?
items.a: Up to 8 with luggage, though 5 to 6 is more comfortable once the bags are loaded.
Message me on WhatsApp with your dates. No deposit and no form before we've actually talked.

quote.text: People ask if I mind when the plan changes last minute. I don't — that's the whole point of doing this myself, not through an agency.

cta.h2: Where would you like to go?
cta.body: Tell me your dates. If it doesn't fit in one day, I'll say so.
